verdict.rationale: macOS documents user-configurable automation via Shortcuts ('Automate tasks with Shortcuts'). It also documents one narrow background monitor, Safari Notify Me, which watches pages for price changes or restocks and alerts the user. The evidence never shows Shortcuts running autonomously in the background on triggers or schedules, and the Siri AI actions described are in-the-moment, user-initiated actions. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled or triggered background execution of user-defined automations, depth of the Shortcuts documentation, agentic or AI-driven autonomous automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
